metric_tips.verify_unavailable: The current collection scope does not record command execution (bash, tests, or builds), so verification duration is unavailable.
metric_tips.stage_estimate: Thinking and execution are approximate metrics inferred from conversation turns and code diffs, including duration estimates.
metric_tips.actual_effort: Actual effort: effective work time spent on this Need with AI assistance. Formula: active session work time + estimated uncovered work.
metric_tips.baseline_effort: Baseline estimate: estimated effort if AI were not used. Formula: combines code-volume estimation, similar historical tasks, and model estimates by confidence.
metric_tips.actual_delivery_time: Actual delivery time: elapsed time from the start of development until this Need was merged. Formula: end time − start time.
metric_tips.baseline_delivery_time: Baseline estimate: expected delivery time without AI at the team's usual working pace. Formula: baseline effort ÷ team work density.
metric_tips.effort_efficiency: Effort efficiency: the share of actual effort saved compared with the baseline estimate. Formula: (baseline effort − actual effort) ÷ actual effort.
metric_tips.calendar_efficiency: Calendar efficiency: the share of actual delivery time saved compared with the baseline estimate. Formula: (baseline delivery time − actual delivery time) ÷ actual delivery time.

project_create.title: Create project
project_create.description: After creation, the project focus view opens so you can add repository sources.
project_create.name: Project name
project_create.missing_id: The created project did not return a project ID.

efficiency_ratio.description: How much faster AI makes delivery; higher is better.
efficiency_ratio.formula: (Baseline delivery time − actual delivery time) ÷ actual delivery time
efficiency_ratio.scope: Decimal ratios are shown as percentages; only merged, eligible, non-outlier Needs are included.

work_caliber.description: Efficiency based on active work minutes instead of elapsed delivery time.
work_caliber.scope: Calendar and effort metrics coexist and independently exclude their respective outliers.

saved_person_days.description: Equivalent person-days saved by AI compared with the baseline.
saved_person_days.formula: max(0, baseline delivery minutes − actual delivery minutes) ÷ 480
saved_person_days.scope: 1 person-day = 480 minutes; only merged, eligible, non-outlier Needs are included.

roi.description: Equivalent labor savings returned per unit of AI cost.
roi.formula: Equivalent savings ÷ AI cost; equivalent savings = person-days saved × person-day rate
roi.scope: The person-day rate comes from System configuration; AI cost uses the dashboard task scope.

ai_code_ratio.description: The share of delivered code generated and adopted with AI.
ai_code_ratio.formula: AI-covered net added lines ÷ total net added lines
ai_code_ratio.scope: Decimal ratios are shown as percentages and weighted by eligible Needs.

cost.formula: Sum input and output token costs using each model's pricing
cost.scope: Dashboard task scope, grouped by session; repository-level commits do not carry token costs.

active_users.description: Unique users who delivered work with AI during the period.
active_users.formula: Distinct users with eligible Needs during the period
active_users.scope: Need participants are counted; commit-only users with no collected session are excluded.

commit_diff_lines.description: Net changed lines committed during the period.
commit_diff_lines.scope: Lines are aggregated directly from commit diffs.

coverage_eligible.description: A Need with complete data that can be included in efficiency metrics.
coverage_eligible.formula: Requires both time and delivery data
coverage_eligible.scope: Needs missing either side, or classified as outliers, are isolated from efficiency calculations.

wow.description: Change from the equally long period immediately before the current one.
wow.scope: No direction indicator is shown when the previous-period value is zero.

merged_need.description: A delivery Need grouped from a feature branch, and the basic unit of efficiency metrics.
merged_need.formula: Group delivery activity by feature branch
merged_need.scope: Commits on default branches such as main, master, develop, and release do not form Needs.

silica.description: The fingerprint-matched share of code attributable to AI.
silica.formula: Match delivered code against collected AI-generated code fingerprints
silica.scope: This is an experimental metric with very low current coverage and is not used as a quality dimension.

dept_efficiency.formula: Aggregate calendar efficiency for eligible Needs
dept_efficiency.scope: Includes members of the selected department and all child departments.
